Contradiction: Evidence 3 (handgun in Faraday's hand) suggests Faraday shot Rell, not simultaneous. Also evidence 4 knife in Rell's hand suggests Rell stabbed Faraday. That could be simultaneous? But evidence 3 says bullet from few yards away, not close range. Testimony says close range. So contradiction between Evidence 3 (or 4) and Testimony 3/4 (close range). Choose one pair. Testimony 4: "That fact indicates that they attacked each other at the same time from close range." So distance contradiction. Evidence 3 says bullet fired from a few yards away (not close). So pair: evidence 3, testimony 4.
